sites.name: Godly
sites.note: 全球优秀网站灵感集，现已跳转至 recent.design
sites.analysis: 全球顶尖网页设计灵感画廊。收录大量沉浸式滚动动效、大胆的字体排版与高对比配色案例，是判断「当前网页设计风向」的标杆站点。
sites.title: Recent — Design Inspiration
sites.description: The best design inspiration on the Internet.

sites.name: Unicorn Studio
sites.note: 你给的是登录后的 dashboard，已改截公开首页
sites.analysis: 面向创意前端的 WebGL 动效工具/案例库。首页即是一组炫目的实时着色器与粒子动效，代表「生成艺术 + 交互动效」在商业网页里的最新应用方式。
sites.title: Unicorn Studio — Craft Interactive Graphics that Ship
sites.description: Design production-ready web components with shaders, media, 3D, and interactive motion in a visual canvas.

sites.name: React Bits
sites.note: 你给的是文档页，已改截首页（动画 showcase 更直观）
sites.analysis: 开源的 React 动效组件库（你项目里正在用）。首页用「实时可交互的动画组件」作为展示，代表了微交互、粒子、文字动效等 UI 细节的前沿做法。
sites.title: React Bits - Animated UI Components For React
sites.description: An open source collection of high quality, animated, interactive & fully customizable React components for building stunning, memorable user interfaces.

sites.name: React Bits Pro
sites.note: 已去掉追踪参数，改截首页
sites.analysis: React Bits 的 Pro 进阶版，提供更复杂的 3D、着色器与高级动效组件，是「商业级前端动效组件」的高质量样本。
sites.title: React Bits Pro | Animated React Components, Blocks & Templates
sites.description: 150 animated React components, 280 page blocks, 300 app UI blocks, 15 templates and an AI Agent Kit. One-time payment, lifetime updates.

sites.name: Huy Phan

sites.title: Huy Phan - Award-winning designer
sites.description: Huy Phan (Huyml) is an award-winning designer and art director based in Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam.

sites.name: Illoca · Unseen

sites.title: illoca – Architectural design at the speed of thought
sites.description: illoca is an AI-native design engine built for professional architects. Explore, refine, and move from first ideas to editable 2D and 3D designs with more speed and control.

sites.name: Merlin Studio
sites.note: 来源：Awwwards 精选（自主搜集）

sites.title: A boutique digital studio turning attention into connection
sites.description: Merlin creates digital experiences that turn attention into brand connections. Building trust, shaping preference and giving a reason to act, stay or return.

sites.name: Sadu Media

sites.title: Sadu Media | Award-Winning Saudi Production House
sites.description: Discover Sadu Media, where creative visions come to life. sites.name: Counter Forms
sites.analysis: 以字体与排版为核心的设计工作室，界面极简、字距与层级精心控制，是「文字即设计」的典范。
sites.title: Counter Forms
sites.description: Counter Forms is a new typographic venture that seeks to champion young, discursive, Antipodean type designers.

sites.name: Snøhetta
sites.analysis: 挪威传奇建筑与设计事务所官网。大图沉浸式叙事 + 克制的信息层级，把建筑作品集做得像展览。
sites.title: Snøhetta
sites.description: Snøhetta is a global transdisciplinary practice. Creating places for societies to connect with each other and with the world around them is a primary motivation in our work. Dialogue and diversity empower this approach.

sites.name: Mobbin
sites.analysis: 全球最大的 App/网页 UI 参考库之一。产品本身设计精美，收录海量真实应用截图，UI 设计师的日常灵感来源。
sites.title: Mobbin — UI & UX design inspiration for mobile & web apps
sites.description: Save hours of UI & UX research with our library of 400,000+ fully searchable mobile & web app screenshots.

sites.name: Refokus
sites.analysis: 专注 B2B 科技创业公司的品牌与网页设计代理。动效克制、面向转化的设计，是服务型机构官网的参考。
sites.title: Branding & Web Design for B2B Tech Startups | Refokus

sites.name: Warren & Mahoney Architects
sites.analysis: 新西兰知名建筑事务所官网。大幅建筑摄影 + 克制的排版做沉浸式作品集叙事，是「建筑/空间类机构」做高级官网的标杆。
sites.title: Warren & Mahoney Architects | Warren and Mahoney
sites.description: We are an architecture practice based in Australia and New Zealand with approximately 350 highly engaged people from 35 countries, all eager to explore how design can meet the needs of a rapidly changing world.

sites.name: Patrick Mason Studio
sites.analysis: 独立设计师 Patrick Mason 的工作室作品集。大胆的排版与精致的交互细节呈现项目，是个人作品集/独立工作室站的高质量样本。
sites.title: Patrick Mason Studio
sites.description: Patrick Mason partners with cultural, commercial and individual clients to create engaging and memorable designs. Based in Eora (Sydney), Australia.

sites.name: Viens-là
sites.analysis: 巴黎数字与品牌设计工作室，专注定制网站与视觉识别，获 Awwwards 认可。官网前卫又克制，是欧洲创意工作室的最新风向。
sites.title: Viens-là | Agence digitale & branding sur-mesure — Paris
sites.description: Studio créatif parisien spécialisé dans la création de sites web et identités visuelles sur-mesure. 15 ans d'expérience, récompensé Awwwards.

sites.name: Middle Name Communications
sites.analysis: 创意传播机构官网，鲜明的品牌调性 + 活泼的动效与排版，代表「创意传播类机构」做官网的潮流做法。
sites.title: Middle Name Communications
sites.description: Visit middlename.co for updates on our website launching soon. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed!

sites.name: AstroDither — Robert Borghesi LAB
sites.analysis: 音频响应的 Three.js/WebGPU 实时流体模拟 + dithering 实验站，SIGNAL LOST 赛博颓废美学拉满，是「生成艺术 + 创意技术」的极致样本。
sites.title: ASTRODITHER — Robert Borghesi LAB — [SIGNAL. LOST. BEAUTY. FOUND. DIGITAL. CHAOS.]
sites.description: [SIGNAL. LOST. BEAUTY. FOUND. DIGITAL. CHAOS.] — AstroDither, an audio reactive Threejs /WebGPU experiment by Robert Borghesi on dithering and fluid simulation with TSL.

sites.name: There's Nothing to Watch
sites.analysis: 用 force-directed + voronoi 图可视化上万部电影，拖动探索的交互感极强，是「交互式数据叙事」的范本级站点。
sites.title: There's nothing to watch
sites.description: Discover movies through an interactive visualization. Explore tens of thousands of films in a unique force-directed voronoi diagram interface.

sites.name: Cathy Dolle
sites.analysis: 交互设计师 Cathy Dolle 的个人站，极简克制却在字距、留白与动效细节上打磨到位，安静而有质感。
sites.title: Cathy DOLLE - Interactive Designer
sites.description: Cathy Dolle is a designer and front-end developer who creates simple, thoughtful digital experiences with a minimalist, detail-driven approach. She enjoys shaping quiet, refined identities and occasionally shares her creative process on Twitch

sites.name: Dirt
sites.analysis: 面向 real-world 品牌的全球创意工作室，官网满是个性与态度、视觉大胆，是「有性格的机构站」风向标。
sites.title: Dirt | Global Creative Studio for Real World Brands
sites.description: Welcome to the Dirtverse. A global creative studio and tangible benchmark for the ambitious. From sick start-ups to cool giants, we build what can’t be ignored.

sites.name: Harry Atkins
sites.analysis: 独立前端开发者的个人站，简洁利落地展示作品与思考，是「开发者做个人站」的高分样板。
